executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort appeared in at least one AI answer for 81.7% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort appeared 31.3% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort in the hotel options surfaced.

Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort appeared in the Top 3 50% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
